svg.title: Field error and correlation answer different questions
svg.desc: Final-time relative L2 error detects both synthetic failures. Spatial Pearson correlation remains one for an additive bias and is undefined for a constant field; the missing value is not replaced by zero. Pair these metrics with initial-condition and mean-budget checks.
